item.title: Police Arrest Man For Alleged Defilement of Six-Year-Old Stepdaughter In Edo
item.dc:creator: New Telegraph
item.description: The operatives of the Edo State Police Command have arrested a man for allegedly defiling his six-year-old stepdaughter in the state. A statement issued by the state command PPRO, Eno Ikoedem, on Wednesday said the suspect was identified as 57-year-old Kadiri Edenokun of Jattu, Auchi, in Edo North.
